comparison_method: Entire original extents including native alignment bytes. Only recorded COFF 32-bit relocation fields are masked; each main-body relocation identity is separately checked against the original call target. A smaller difference count is not a successful reconstruction.

groups.name: UnsignedState
groups.scope: Scalar versus two/three-entry predictor state arrays, declaration position, and output/state assignment order.

groups.name: UnsignedQualifiers
groups.scope: Diagnostic volatile qualification of output/history/codebook pointer targets; unsupported qualifiers are not promoted.

groups.name: UnsignedLoop
groups.scope: One, two, or four manually expanded pairs inside signed/unsigned for/do/countdown loops.

groups.name: UnsignedHistorical
groups.scope: Reuse of packet-copy temporary/source index for sample temporaries, unused historical locals, header temporary, and packet-array declaration position.

groups.name: UnsignedAggregate
groups.scope: Structure/union/one-element-array predictor state with direct or force-inlined updates.

groups.name: UnsignedLong
groups.scope: unsigned int versus unsigned long for coefficients, predictor state, phase shift, and residual samples.

groups.name: UnsignedStatements
groups.scope: Single-expression versus compound-statement predictor arithmetic, packet-copy local reuse, coefficient and history initialization order.

groups.name: UnsignedOutputs
groups.scope: Explicit decoded-sample recurrence using sixteen/eighteen-entry arrays or scalar temporaries, output order, and direct initial history loads.

groups.name: MainHistorical
groups.scope: Unused original SLIST wrapper locals, outer versus inner destination pointer, source count reuse, postdecrement loop, and initial arithmetic order.

groups.name: MainLocalReuse
groups.scope: Original SLIST copy/accumulator/result local reuse, named constant downshift and unused outer locals; verifies the standalone signed helper as a control.

groups.name: MainParameters
groups.scope: Diagnostic register/volatile qualifiers on output, count, context, and history; unsupported qualifiers are not promoted.

groups.name: MainHistory
groups.scope: Equivalent history pointer spellings, context alias, and history pointer initialization before/after LoadAudioHistory. Before-call initialization is explicitly contradicted by target load order.

conclusions: No new exact kernel body. Canonical 37/41 grouped matches, signed 560-byte helper, initialized data, strong BSS and existing behavior proofs remain unchanged.

Reusing both signed packet-copy temporaries for unsigned prediction yields the target 752-byte extent but 597 differing byte positions; its predictor spill structure still differs. It is not promoted merely for matching extent.
All sixteen local-reuse controls preserve the signed helper exactly; every corresponding main expansion remains 864 bytes with 620 masked differences.
Loading the history pointer before LoadAudioHistory changes main to 402 differing positions but contradicts the target post-call pointer load. The lower count does not justify the source change.
Both public inline ANY definitions can link, but earlier group11 compilation omits its unreferenced inline helper. No fake reference or ownership workaround was added.
